criteria.requirement: A parser that takes raw formatted military text (USMTF format), extracts frequency plans, crypto change-over windows, and flight quarters event times, and plots them on a consolidated visual timeline.
criteria.detail: No actual-format specification or SME-reviewed mapping is supplied. The implemented synthetic EVENT/TASK review and UTC timeline slice cannot establish USMTF extraction or domain category correctness.

criteria.requirement: Every extracted field has exact source offsets.
criteria.detail: Every extracted field retains a half-open UTF-16 span whose slice equals its literal source text in the immutable original; the user can inspect source evidence and export it after explicit review. — demonstrated by trace-review-export, draft-approval-boundary at both viewport sizes.

Empty text, missing timezone, invalid calendar dates and unsupported lines produce specific issues and no approved schedule or invented timestamps; correcting the source permits deliberate review and a valid schedule. — demonstrated by invalid-source-recovery, draft-approval-boundary at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Normalize time zones without shifting the event.
criteria.detail: 09:00Z and 04:00-05:00 normalize to 2026-11-04T09:00:00.000Z. A 23:30Z–00:30Z interval remains 60 minutes, displays 23:30–24:00 on November 4 and 00:00–00:30 on November 5, and exports its original complete normalized interval. — demonstrated by utc-day-boundary at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Review output against an independent answer key.
criteria.detail: No independently authored held-out corpus, human reviewer, matching rules or agreed accuracy threshold is supplied. Planner-authored regression cases are protected from build drift but are not independent SME ground truth.

The self-contained local workflow and reviewed export are planned and exercised by trace-review-export, but the allowed declarative browser steps cannot disconnect the browser or prove network isolation. A witnessed disconnected end-to-end run is required; local packaging alone is only a partial demonstration.

criteria.requirement: A tool that seamlessly converts mock USMTF raw text into a synchronized 24-hour visual schedule for watchstanders and shipboard leaders.
criteria.detail: No reviewed mock-USMTF mapping or owner assessment of synchronized/seamless behavior is supplied. The demonstrated UTC 24-hour synthetic timeline and manual category review remain a partial slice, not the complete deliverable.
